Thank ya'll for giving us Atlanta kids in the 80's good guys to cheer for! Love and respect.


Dale Murphy (@DaleMurphy3)

Bob Horner and I were destined to be teammates somewhere. I signed a letter of intent to play baseball at Arizona State before I was drafted. Bob played at ASU and ended up in Atlanta my first full year in the major leagues—1978. One way or another, it was bound to happen. 

From the minute Bob Horner joined the Braves, all us players could see he was good. I mean… really go

Usually Went "Man, guess what Yo/Ya'll mama done did this time".


AMARA (@Amy_beke)

Do you guys say "my mom" or "our mom" when talking to your siblings?



— https://nitter.net/Amy_beke/status/2059579379152248907#m

Class Act.....🫡


Mike Piazza (@mikepiazza31)

Prayers for the soul of Bob Horner, He was part of my teenage years and I was a major fan of his hitting style,  I used to love to watch the @Braves on TBS. He was an inspiration and a great RHH.. Condolences to his and the Braves family..



— https://nitter.net/mikepiazza31/status/2059601609487781901#m

Beautiful to Read The OG Getting Love


Dizzy Wright (@DizzyWright)

Peace to @jermainedupri . My name is Dizzy Wright.

Around 2000, my mom brought me and my brother to meet with you about signing to your label. Long story short… you told us we weren’t ready.

You can see it in the photo. There wasn’t really anything “cool” about us. Just two poor kids trying to figure it out. Hell, my mom couldn’t even afford contacts at the time.

But that meeting changed my life. It was the first time somebo

🙏🏾


Torraine Walker (@TorraineWalker)

This brother was the last surviving link to the Jazz Age, the Harlem Renaissance, Duke Ellington, Miles Davis, Dizzy, Coltrane, Ella, Charlie Parker, Monk, all the way up to the Marsalises, Joshua Redman and Christian McBride in the present day. 

Rest in Power. 🎼🎶🎷



— https://nitter.net/TorraineWalker/status/2059320598396850340#m

I know we got advocates in Baseball heaven, Atlanta.  RIP, Bob.  Thank u for all the memories. #GoBraves #TellBoBobbyAndTedWeMissThem2


Atlanta Braves (@Braves)









— https://nitter.net/Braves/status/2059361572611412124#m

🫡🇺🇸🔴⚫️🟢


carlito (@NorthEastGroove)

Reminder that the first Memorial Day was celebrates by former enslaved African Americans in Charleston, SC in 1865. It was first known as Decoration Day.







— https://nitter.net/NorthEastGroove/status/2058882015693263210#m

Team Work.  Team work will take the state.  Bravo to these two!


Greg Bluestein (@bluestein)

Jon Ossoff is making two big bets in his reelection campaign:

Run harder against Donald Trump in a state Trump carried in 2024.

And lock arms early with Keisha Lance Bottoms to show Democrats are unified while Republicans slog through costly runoffs. #gapol





— https://nitter.net/bluestein/status/2058873231109509138#m

@theswagshopedgewood has always been about more than cuts — it’s about community. Atlanta helped us establish roots, and now we’re honoring those same values as we grow. Big love to @Square for being part of the journey. #ad

I woke up with ‘Mania on my Mind. This beat is so cold I had to kill it. Don’t trip Cody, minor setback for a major comeback and congrats to Jey for getting his first World Title! Inspired By Old Atlanta & TBS! #wrestling #codyrhodes #jeyuso #rap #atlanta
Had to get bro right before his show in the A tomorrow @Tommy Richman
To laugh at another man’s fault is to make their same mistake yourself..#addiction #killamike #runthejewels
